svg.title: Scheduled S3 batch pipeline architecture
svg.desc: EventBridge Scheduler starts Step Functions every two hours. A Lambda claims and preflights up to 300 new raw S3 objects per batch, storing status in DynamoDB. Valid Parquet keys go to Glue and curated S3; rejected files go through a quarantine Lambda to quarantine S3. The workflow repeats until no files remain, then publishes an SNS summary. CloudWatch monitors logs, metrics, and failures.
svg.text: Two-hour kickoff · batches of up to 300 · immediate continuation until the raw prefix is drained
DATA PLANE · CLASSIFY → TRANSFORM OR QUARANTINE
After Glue / quarantine outcomes, repeat discovery
